  have h_expand : (a + b) ^ 2 = a * a + a * b + b * a + b * b := by
    calc
      (a + b) ^ 2 = (a + b) * (a + b) := by simp [pow_two]
      _ = a * (a + b) + b * (a + b) := by rw [add_mul]
      _ = (a * a + a * b) + (b * a + b * b) := by
        rw [mul_add, mul_add]
      _ = a * a + a * b + b * a + b * b := by
        ac_rfl
  have h_sq : a * a + a * b + b * a + b * b = a + b := by
    calc
      a * a + a * b + b * a + b * b = (a + b) ^ 2 := h_expand.symm
      _ = a + b := hab
  have h_eq : a + a * b + b * a + b = a + b := by
    simpa [haa, hbb] using h_sq
  have h_mixed : a * b + b * a = 0 := by
    have h_cancel : a * b + b * a + b = b := by
      have h : a + (a * b + b * a + b) = a + b := by
        calc
          a + (a * b + b * a + b) = a + a * b + b * a + b := by
            ac_rfl
          _ = a + b := h_eq
      exact add_left_cancel h
    have h : (a * b + b * a) + b = 0 + b := by
      simpa using h_cancel
    exact add_right_cancel h
  have h_left : a * b + a * (b * a) = 0 := by
    simpa [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, haa] using
      congrArg (fun x : R => a * x) h_mixed
  have h_right : a * (b * a) + b * a = 0 := by
    simpa [add_mul, mul_assoc, haa] using
      congrArg (fun x : R => x * a) h_mixed
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  calc
    a * b - b * a =
        (a * b + a * (b * a)) - (a * (b * a) + b * a) := by
          abel
    _ = 0 - 0 := by rw [h_left, h_right]
    _ = 0 := by simp
